overview.description: Tractor (拖拉机 Tuō Lā Jī), also known as Sheng Ji (升级, 'Level Up'), is one of the most popular card games in China. It is a 4-player partnership trick-taking game using two standard decks (108 cards). The unique feature is a dynamic trump system where the trump rank changes as teams 'level up' from 2 through Ace. Point cards are K=10, 10=10, 5=5.
overview.originName: 拖拉机 (Tuō Lā Jī) / 升级 (Shēngjí)

history.origins: Tractor (Sheng Ji) evolved in China from the older single-deck point-trick game known as sishi fen (40 points), expanding to two or more decks. It belongs to the Sheng Ji (upgrade) family with zhao pengyou (finding friends). By the late 20th century it had become the most widely played card game in mainland China, especially in Shanghai and south of the Yellow River, where it largely displaced the older single-deck form. Played across China and in Chinese diaspora communities with regional rule variation.
timeline: 1960s–1980s: Tractor (Sheng Ji) developed in China from single-deck point-trick games.
Late 20th century: Becomes the most widespread card game in mainland China; regional variants spread.
Present: Played across China and in Chinese diaspora communities with many house rules.
history.evolution: Many regional variants. Core mechanic (leveling up) is universal.
history.cultural: The most widespread card game in mainland China.

setup.deck: 108 cards (2 standard decks with Jokers). Point cards: K=10, 10=10, 5=5. Total 200 points.
setup.dealing: Deal 25 each. 8 to Kitty. Declarer takes Kitty, discards 8.

rules.objective: Attackers try to score 80+ points. Defenders try to prevent it. Winners level up.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal while declaring trump suit (show trump rank card). 2. Declarer takes 8-card Kitty, discards 8. 3. Play tricks: Lead single, pair, or 'Tractor' (consecutive pairs). Follow suit/structure. Trump if void. 4. Last trick: Kitty points doubled to attackers. 5. Score 200 total points. Attackers need 80+.
keyRules: Kitty points doubled on last trick

strategy.basic: Control trumps. Don't give away 10s and Ks in losing tricks. Protect the Kitty.
strategy.intermediate: Use Tractors to sweep tricks. Void a suit to trump effectively.
strategy.advanced: Calculate remaining trumps. Manipulate the Kitty for maximum defense. Coordinate with partner.
tips: The trump rank card in trump suit is second-highest.
Level up faster by winning big.

difficulty.hard: Perfect trump tracking; optimal Kitty decisions.

phases.label: Deal
phases.notes: Each player in turn draws one card from the top counterclockwise until each has 25; 8 remain as kitty.

phases.label: Declare trump
phases.notes: During deal, players may expose trump rank card or pair to set trump suit; pair of jokers = no trump.

phases.label: Take kitty
phases.notes: Starter takes 8 kitty cards, adds to hand, discards 8 face down. Starter leads first trick.

phases.label: Play tricks
phases.notes: Lead single, pair, tractor (consecutive pairs), or top set. Follow suit. Trick winner leads next.

phases.label: Score
phases.notes: Count opponents' points (K=10, 10=10, 5=5). If opponents have 80+, they become declarers. Level up by margin.

play_card.description: Play one or more cards to the current trick: a single card, an identical pair, a tractor (consecutive identical pairs in the same suit), or a set of top cards. Must follow suit and structure when possible. Trick winner leads to the next trick.
play_card.constraints: Must follow suit when possible. When a pair or tractor is led, play same number of cards with pairs or tractors in the led suit if possible. When trump is led, must play trump if held.

trumpConfig.trumpSuitRanking: Red joker, black joker, trump rank in trump suit, other cards of trump rank (equal), then trump suit Ace down to 2. Non-trump suits rank A down to 2 omitting trump rank.
trumpConfig.overtakingRule: Pair of identical trumps beats unpaired trumps. Consecutive pairs (tractor) beat lower consecutive pairs. Must follow with same structure when possible.

trickConfig.leadRestrictions: Lead a single card, an identical pair, a tractor (consecutive identical pairs in same suit), or a set of top cards of a suit.

engine.deckDescription: Two standard 52-card French decks plus four jokers (two red, two black), 108 cards total. Four suits with thirteen ranks each, each rank appearing four times (twice per deck). Jokers are the highest trumps; one suit and one rank are trumps each deal.
engine.suitDescription: Four traditional French suits: Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, and Spades. Each suit appears 26 times (two per deck). Trump suit is declared during the deal; trump rank equals the declarers' current level from 2 through Ace.
engine.rankDescription: Standard ranks Ace through 2, each appearing eight times (four per suit across two decks). The trump rank varies by deal (declarers' level). Point cards: King and 10 worth 10 each, 5 worth 5; 200 points total per round.
engine.dealPattern: Each player in turn draws one card from the top counterclockwise until each has 25; 8 cards remain as kitty. Starter takes the 8 kitty cards, adds them to hand, and discards 8 face down.
